messages:
sam: heads-up — running into ambiguous client behavior during batching shims. Some clients send `X-Redwood-Batch: v2` and others still use `batch_mode=1` in querystring. We need a single negotiation path.
maggie: Ugh. Which endpoints? generation only or embeddings too?
sam: generation + streaming. streaming clients don't tolerate envelope wrapping. If we change wire shape, they'll drop.
jordan: quick idea: accept both for 6 months, return `Warning` header when legacy param used, emit telemetry. Add strictness behind `x-rw-compat: strict` header for opt-in clients.
elaine: agree. But streaming parsing cost spikes. How do we avoid perf cliff? Maybe route legacy -> sidecar proxy that unwraps/rewraps.
raul: sidecar adds infra burden. What about doing runtime shim in the ingress that only unmarshals prefix frames (cheap) and forward rest as-is?
maggie: can we detect by `Content-Type: application/x-ndjson` vs `application/json+envelope`? Some clients indistinguishable.
sam: snippet of negotiation logic I hacked:\n\n```\nif req.headers['x-rw-compat'] == 'strict':\n  enforce_new_shape(req)\nelif 'batch_mode' in req.query or req.headers.get('x-old-batch'):\n  mark_legacy(req)\nelse:\n  infer_shape_lazy(req)\n```\n\nmaggie: telemetry question: we'll need counts for legacy vs new, plus error rate per-tenant. Add `compat_migration` metric with tags.
jordan: rollout plan proposal: 1) accept both shapes with soft-warning for 3 months. 2) After telemetry shows >90% new, start 30-day strict headers for flagged tenants. 3) Deprecation notice and final cut.
elaine: owners? infra for ingress shim = eng-infra, runtime changes = eng-runtime. I'll sync with @ops-bot to add canary.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: ingress-shim-canary to staging at 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC (ticket INF-1234)
sam: ok I'll draft RFC with explicit API examples and error codes. Action items: sam RFC, maggie metrics, jordan rollout doc, raul perf benchmark by end of week. :thumbsup: 
maggie: noted. I'll add a Grafana panel and alert (too many legacy requests) :chart_with_upwards_trend: 
raul: perf bench results: naive unwrap adds ~1.8ms median, worst-case 6ms under load. pushing sidecar would negate runtime hotpath. I'll upload numbers.
sam: thanks. meeting tomorrow 10am PT to finalize. /remind #architecture tomorrow 10am finalize shim cutover
